key_insight: A modular automated X-ray inspection system was designed and experimentally validated for pipe weld inspection with ±1 mm positioning accuracy.
engineering_relevance: The system supports internal or external inspection of pipes 40–508 mm in diameter and 6–12 m long, depending on pipe diameter.
method: Surveyed factory layout and overhead-crane feeding requirements.
Integrated rail-guided transport, servo positioning, laser verification, and absolute-encoder feedback.
Performed finite element structural analysis and tested the manufactured system.
evidence_signal: Reported peak stresses were 133.5 MPa in the arm and 211.1 MPa in the rail vehicle, with safety factors of 3.1 and 1.96; experimental tests validated the simulations.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify defect-detection performance, inspection throughput, or radiation-safety provisions.
paper_title: Design and Validation of an Automated X-Ray Imaging System for Pipe Weld Inspection
